subject: Mutual Action Plan — Dedicated GPU capacity kickoff with QuantaFinance
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Sara Albright <sara.albright@quantafin.com>, Procurement <procurement@quantafin.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-28T09:07:00-08:00
Subject: Mutual Action Plan kickoff for Dedicated GPU capacity (QuantaFinance)

Hi Sara (and team),

Thanks again for the conversation yesterday — excited to move from discovery to a concrete Mutual Action Plan (MAP) so we can close on dedicated capacity for your production inference needs. I attached a first-pass MAP and a throughput projection workbook for the pilot. High-level asks in this kickoff:

- Confirm stakeholders and role ownership (single owners for acceptance, procurement, infra).
- Align on pilot throughput targets: baseline 800 tokens/sec sustained per pool, 2x burst capacity for peak windows; we can calibrate after week 1 of the trial.
- Agree evaluation criteria and the timeline to close (kickoff -> pilot -> evaluation -> commitment).

Proposed short timeline:
- Nov 29: stakeholder rollcall + final MAP v1 signoff
- Dec 6: pilot starts (2-week pilot)
- Dec 20: evaluation review and go/no-go for reserved capacity

Please review the attached MAP-draft-v1.pdf and the throughput-projections.xlsx. If the timeline is tight for procurement, flag that and we'll surface a temporary trial agreement.

Who will be the primary acceptance owner on your side? Also, is there any specific telemetry or audit retention requirement we should add to the MAP?

Thanks,
Priyom
Sr. Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
Attachments: MAP-draft-v1.pdf (11KB), throughput-projections.xlsx (28KB)

- I'll own throughput verification (benchmarks and SW load test schedule).

Priyom / Ben — thanks, this looks good. A couple quick notes from our side:

- Acceptance owner: I'll be the product lead owner; procurement will be looped for contracting.
- Throughput targets: 800 tokens/sec baseline is in line with our SLOs; can you confirm how you measure sustained throughput (90th vs median)?
- Security/retention: we need 13 months of audit log retention and KMS integration. I see you have a private deployment option noted in the MAP — we'll need the private control plane for audit purposes.

Procurement: our PM will need a short SOW and pricing cadence to move internal approvals — procurement@quantafin.com, can you confirm earliest review date?

Sara
Head of Applied ML, QuantaFinance

Hi all — adding a couple procurement and billing notes so timelines are realistic:

- If QuantaFinance needs the private control plane + KMS, that typically adds a 2–3 week lead for network setup and customer KMS onboarding. We can start parallel work during the pilot but full private deployment may push the final commitment date out to early January unless we accept a short-term hosted-to-private migration.
- I'll prepare a draft SOW and a committed pricing example by Dec 3.
- Also attaching an SLA-exception-request.docx for the specific throughput SLO ask (you'll see a placeholder for 2x burst).

Laura Bennett
Senior Finance Ops Manager | Redwood Inference
Attachments: SLA-exception-request.docx (6KB)

Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan kickoff for Dedicated GPU capacity (QuantaFinance)

Great — thanks for the quick feedback, Sara. To answer your throughput question: we define sustained throughput as the 95th-percentile sustained token output measured across 5-minute windows during the load test; Ben will own the exact test harness and will share the script and raw results during the pilot.

Next concrete steps:
- Nov 30: stakeholder confirmation (Sara = acceptance owner, procurement contact TBD) — ACTION: procurement@quantafin.com to reply to this thread with earliest review date.
- Dec 1–3: Redwood to finalize SOW and send to procurement (Laura will send Dec 3).
- Dec 6: Pilot onboarding (Marissa will send runbook and dashboard invite).

I'll attach a revised MAP v1.1 after Laura's SOW edit; noting that private control plane and KMS are marked as required by QuantaFinance — we've added a migration plan in section 4.

If procurement confirms a review by Dec 2 we can keep the Dec 6 pilot start. Otherwise we can start a hosted pilot on Dec 6 and run the private migration in parallel.

Thanks everyone — I will update the HubSpot record and drop the DocuSign link once the SOW is finalized.

Priyom
Sr. Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
Attachments: MAP-draft-v1.pdf (updated), throughput-projections.xlsx (updated)
